t: Richard Lawrence became the first person to attempt to assassinate a sitting US president when he failed to kill Andrew Jackson at the US Capitol and was subdued by the crowd.
An earthquake registering approximately 8.5 Mw devastated Concepción, Chile, and triggered a tsunami that destroyed neighbouring Talcahuano.
The New York Sun perpetrated the Great Moon Hoax, publishing articles about the supposed discovery of life on the Moon.

Mexican dragoons dispatched to disarm settlers at Gonzales in Mexican Texas encountered stiff resistance from a Texian militia at the Battle of Gonzales, the first armed engagement of the Texas Revolution.
In the first major engagement of the Texas Revolution, the Texian Army repelled a Mexican attack at the grounds of Mission Concepcion south of Downtown San Antonio.
Texas Revolution: Texian forces attacked a Mexican pack train, capturing 40 saddlebags of grass.
James Pratt and John Smith became the last people to be executed in England for sodomy.
